title: BioKERN: Biological Kernel Regularization for Histology-to-Transcriptomics Neighborhood Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2608.24823v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Spatially resolved biology requires representations that preserve biological neighborhood structure rather than only exact cross-modal correspondences. Existing histology--transcriptomics objectives can emphasize instance-level matching even when non-paired spots share molecular or spatial context. We introduce BioKERN, a multimodal spatial representation-learning framework that incorporates biological structure as an explicit, learnable inductive bias. BioKERN constructs a training-time biological kernel by combining transcriptomic similarity and spatial proximity, then uses it to provide graded neighborhood supervision and regularize embedding geometry. Evaluation uses a fixed, model-independent biological neighborhood definition shared by all methods. Across Mouse Brain Visium and Human Liver GSE240429, BioKERN consistently improves biological-neighborhood retrieval over BLEEP in both single- and multi-scale settings. Controlled share

translated_title: BioKERN：用于组织学-转录组学邻域检索的生物学核正则化
translated_abstract: 空间解析生物学需要保留生物学邻域结构的表征，而不仅仅是精确的跨模态对应关系。现有的组织学-转录组学目标可能强调实例级匹配，即使非配对位点共享分子或空间背景。我们引入了BioKERN，一种多模态空间表征学习框架，将生物学结构作为显式、可学习的归纳偏置纳入其中。BioKERN通过结合转录组相似性和空间邻近性构建训练时的生物学核，然后利用它提供分级邻域监督并正则化嵌入几何。评估使用所有方法共享的固定、模型无关的生物学邻域定义。在小鼠脑Visium和人类肝脏GSE240429数据集上，BioKERN在单尺度和多尺度设置中均持续优于BLEEP在生物学邻域检索方面的表现。
tldr: BioKERN通过引入可学习的生物学核正则化，显式建模邻域结构，在组织学-转录组学检索任务中显著提升了生物学邻域的检索性能。
en_tdlr: BioKERN introduces a learnable biological kernel regularization that explicitly models neighborhood structure, consistently improving biological-neighborhood retrieval in histology-to-transcriptomics tasks.
